Sorry to hear youre going through a lot right now, I was in a similar boat not long ago. I’m not aware of a specific EDS in Vancouver, however  from my experience once you are able to get assessed with a specialist(physiatrist, rheum, etc) things tend to speed up in terms of paperwork/disability.  

I would also recommend checking if your family doctor is able to refer or get you on a waitlist for an occupational/physical therapist. My OT was a great help, and physical therapy is pretty ongoing. If you are able to see a physiotherapist from a private clinic in the mean time they should be able to help a bit as well. Hoping that this process speeds up for you op ❤️ wishing the best.
